ORDER Signed by: SOURABH YADAV Signing time: 20/07/2023 5:49:08 PM

In the instant petition, a challenge has been made to the order dated 27.05.203 passed by Sub-divisional Officer Ghatiya Distict Ujjain, whereby, the petitioner has been placed under suspension on the post of Sarpanch under section 39(1)(a) of the MP Panchayat Raj Avam Gram Swaraj Adhiniyam, 1993 (hereinafter referred as "Adhiniyam").
2.

entities.text: MP Panchayat Raj Avam Gram Swaraj Adhiniyam, 1993
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that as per the provisions of section 39(1)(a) of the Act,
the Office Bearer of Panchayat can be placed under suspension only when the charge is framed under any criminal case mentioned under the said section.
It is argued that in the present case, a case under NDPS Act is registered against the petitioner but no charge has been framed till this date.

3. By order dated 24.07.2023, the learned counsel for the respondent/state was directed to ascertain whether the charge has been framed against the petitioner in the case registered against him under NDPS Act at police station DUG vide FIR No.208/2022.
4.

The respondents filed reply on 13.07.2023 and raised preliminary objection regarding maintainability of the petition on the ground of availability of alternative and efficacious remedy under MP Panchayat (Appeal and Revision) Rules, 1995 but in the said reply, the respondents have not stated that the charges have been framed or not.
5.
The petitioner has made specific averment in para no.5.6 and 5.8 that no charge has been framed in the said criminal case.

In reply to the para 5.6 and 5.8, the respondents have only stated that the criminal case is registered against the petitioner but they have not stated that whether the charges have been framed or not.
The reply is silent on the said aspect.
6. So far the objection of the respondent regarding maintainability of petition on the ground of availability of alternative and efficacious remedy is concerned, the law is no longer res-integra.

The availability of alternative and efficacious remedy is not an absolute bar for this Court to exercise jurisdiction under Article 226 of the Constitution of India when the impugned order suffers from jurisdictional error, arbitrariness or violation of statutory provisions.

A reference may be made to the judgment passed by the Apex Court in the case o f Whirlpool Corporation Vs. Registrar of Trade Mark reported in (1998) 8 SCC 1.
7.

entities.text: Whirlpool Corporation Vs. Registrar of Trade Mark reported in (1998) 8 SCC 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Now, adverting to the merit of the case, the petitioner has specifically pleaded that no charge has been framed in the present case, therefore, the petitioner could not have been placed under suspension under section 39 (1)(a) of the Adhiniyam.
There is no reply to the aforesaid contention.
This Court has specifically made query in this regard from the counsel for the state by order dated 27.04.2023 but the reply is silent on that point.

8. After hearing learned counsel for the parties, it is apposite to refer relevant provision of section 39(1)(a) of the Adhiniyam, which reads as under:-

2 "39. Suspension of office-bearer of Panchayat.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
- (1) The prescribed authority may suspend from office any office-bearer,-
(a) against whom charges have been framed in any criminal proceedings under [Chapters V-A, VI, IX], IX-A, X, XII, Sections 302, 303, 304-B, 305, 306, 312 to 318,
366-A, 366-B, 373 to 377 of Chapter XVI, Sections 395 to 398, 408, 409, 458 lo 460 of Chapter XVII and Chapter XVIII of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (XLV of 1860) or under any Law for the time being in force for the prevention of adulteration of food stuff and drugs, [suppression of immoral traffic in women and children, Protection of Civil Rights and Prevention of Corruption];
9. Upon perusal of the aforesaid provisions, it is manifest that Prescribed Authority may suspend any office bearer against whom charges have been framed in any criminal proceedings under the provisions mentioned in the IPC or any law in the time being in force.
10.
Since, the charge has not been framed in the criminal case against the petitioner, the impugned order of suspension is patently contrary to the provisions of section 39(1)(a) of the Adhiniyam.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
The impugned suspension order is quashed.
Liberty is granted to the Prescribed Authority to pass fresh order of suspension after framing of charge in accordance of law.

(VIJAY KUMAR SHUKLA) JUDGE Sourabh Farooq Khan @ Farooq Lala vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142793964/
